title: K-19: The Widowmaker
description: The commander (Harrison Ford) of a Russian submarine tries to avert a disaster after a nuclear reactor malfunctions.

title: The Battle of Algiers
description: Between 1954 and '62, Algeria fights for independence from the French.

title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
description: Filmmaker Ed Wood Jr.'s laughable tale of alien invaders and resurrected corpses in the San Fernando Valley.

title: Poolhall Junkies
description: A billiards player ends his conflicted friendship with a con man who taught him how to play the game.

title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
description: Bald, pale, tired and cursed with immortality, Count Dracula (Klaus Kinski) visits a plague of rats upon Europe.

title: Coffee and Cigarettes
description: Vignettes revolve around a dentist appointment, a talkative waiter, musicians and celebrities.

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: Swords of Vengeance
description: Loyal vassals and samurai join forces to avenge the unjust execution of a lord in Japan.

title: Piranhaconda
description: After a deranged scientist steals the egg of a hybrid animal, members of a film crew run from the creature before the people become its dinner.

title: Dauntless: The Battle of Midway
description: Two men fight for survival after their plane crashes into the Pacific Ocean during the Battle of Midway.

title: A Tale of Two Guns
description: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

title: Hoop Dreams
description: Filmmakers chronicle more than four years in the lives of two urban Chicago youths in pursuit of pro basketball stardom.

title: Blind Dating
description: After his brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of disastrous dates, a blind man (Chris Pine) falls in love with a nurse (Anjali Jay) from his doctor's office.

title: Tragedy Girls
description: Teenage crime reporters Sadie and McKayla are hot on the trail of a crazed serial killer. After capturing the maniac and holding him hostage, they soon realize that the best way to boost their social media stardom is to commit the murders themselves.

title: The Boys From Brazil
description: An old Nazi-hunter (Laurence Olivier) finds Josef Mengele (Gregory Peck) and a cohort (James Mason) in the jungle, cloning Hitler for the Fourth Reich.

title: Rock 'n' Roll High School
description: A teenager (P.J. Soles) and her friends get even with their principal to music by the Ramones.

title: The Lawnmower Man
description: A scientist uses an intellectually disabled gardener as a guinea pig in his experiments with intelligence enhancing drugs and virtual reality. The man transforms into a genius, but not without side effects.

title: The Pledge
description: A detective about to retire promises a woman to catch her daughter's murderer.

title: Night of the Demons
description: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

title: Galaxy of Terror
description: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

title: The Killer
description: Bound by honor and obsession, a Hong Kong hit man (Chow Yun-Fat) and a policeman (Danny Lee) come to respect each other.

title: Take Back
description: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

title: Legionnaire
description: A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.

title: Georgia Rule
description: Exasperated with her rebellious daughter (Lindsay Lohan), a woman (Felicity Huffman) sends the teen to Idaho to live with her own stern mother (Jane Fonda).

title: The Loft
description: Paranoia grips a group of married men (Karl Urban, James Marsden, Wentworth Miller) who find the dead body of an unknown woman in the penthouse they share for extramarital trysts.

title: Class of 1984
description: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

title: Unlawful Entry
description: A creepy policeman (Ray Liotta) gets close to a Los Angeles couple (Kurt Russell, Madeleine Stowe) in order to drive them apart.

title: House
description: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

title: Rough Magic
description: A sleazy politician sends an agent (Russell Crowe) after his ex-fiancee (Bridget Fonda), who fled to Mexico with incriminating film of him.

title: Assault on Precinct 13
description: Cops and convicts join forces to defend a barren police station from a vengeance-seeking street gang.

title: The Killing Time
description: A stranger's (Kiefer Sutherland) arrival changes a California sheriff's (Beau Bridges) plan to kill his lover's husband (Wayne Rogers).

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: Jesus' teachings and miracles draw large crowds.

title: Deathstalker II
description: Hero Deathstalker (John Terlesky) helps Princess Evie (Monique Gabrielle) reclaim her throne from a sorcerer (John La Zar) and his Princess Evie clone.

title: Space Truckers
description: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

title: Bad Timing: A Sensual Obsession
description: A Viennese detective (Harvey Keitel) asks an American psychiatrist (Art Garfunkel) about his lustful girlfriend (Theresa Russell) in the emergency room.

title: Dead Man
description: Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.

title: Justin Bieber's Believe
description: Pop superstar Justin Bieber talks about his music, relationships and growing up in the spotlight. Concert footage, behind-the-scenes access, and appearances by Usher, Ludacris and other performers augment Bieber's narrative.

title: Gerry
description: After stopping their car for a hike, two men (Casey Affleck, Matt Damon) get lost in the desert without food or water.

title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

title: Guns of Redemption
description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel.

title: The Kid
description: The Little Tramp (Charlie Chaplin) raises the abandoned child (Jack Coogan) of an unwed mother (Edna Purviance).

title: Starcrash
description: A space explorer and his girlfriend try to protect Earth from devastation.
